content.intro: M2: Energy Access and Inclusive Energy Services

content.text:
This chapter serves as a guide for building energy systems that revolve around well-being, sustainability, and justice.

In our exploration, we will discuss innovative solutions for energy access, policy mechanisms to expand energy access, the pivotal roles of partnerships and stakeholders, community-based approaches. We also take a deeper dive into the crucial aspects of affordability, inclusivity, and an intersectional approach.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: An Intersectional Approach to Energy Access
lessons.description: This lesson explores how an intersectional approach can transform energy access by addressing the overlapping identities that shape people's experience and challenges. The lesson presents practical strategies to operationalize intersectionality in sustainable energy access programming.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Technological Solutions to reach Universal Energy Access
lessons.description: The lesson highlights the key technological solutions that can accelerate the path towards universal energy access while supporting the transition to clean energy.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Business models and Financing Mechanisms for Energy Access
lessons.description: This lesson explains how financing mechanisms and business models can incentivize energy access and inclusive energy services with a focus on underserved and vulnerable communities.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Policy Frameworks for Energy Access
lessons.description: This lesson explores three policy instruments: subsidies, tax incentives and regulatory reforms, and how they contribute to the promotion of sustainable energy solutions.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Unlocking Energy Access with Digital Tools, Data and AI
lessons.description: This lesson explores the importance of multi-stakeholder partnerships and the role of international organizations, NGOs, development agencies, the private sector and local communities in advancing energy access objectives, as well as the associated challenges and conflicts.
